system.description:
No price in Emberglow is the real price. Once per visit to a settlement, test Presence DR12 before you trade. This applies to gear and services, not to valuables or relics.
Triumph: Until you leave, you buy at three-quarters of the price and sell gear at its full price.
Success: Until you leave, choose one: you buy at three-quarters of the price, or you sell gear at three-quarters of its price instead of half.
Failure: You pay and are paid the usual prices.
Ruin: Word gets around. Until your next Downtime, every merchant in that settlement charges you a quarter more.
